description: Source code for email batching functionality in Mattermost, including classes and methods for batching, scheduling, and sending notification emails.

classes.name: postData
classes.description: Data structure representing the content of a post in email notifications.

classes.name: EmailBatchingJob
classes.description: Class managing batching, scheduling, and processing of email notifications.

methods.name: InitEmailBatching
methods.description: Initializes email batching if enabled in configuration.

methods.name: AddNotificationEmailToBatch
methods.description: Adds a notification email to the batching queue or falls back to immediate send if full.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the recurring email batching task.

methods.name: CheckPendingEmails
methods.description: Checks and processes pending batched emails.

methods.name: handleNewNotifications
methods.description: Handles incoming notifications and adds them to pending list.

methods.name: checkPendingNotifications
methods.description: Checks which notifications are ready to be sent based on timing and user activity.

methods.name: sendBatchedEmailNotification
methods.description: Constructs and sends a batched email notification to a user.
